title: Revenue Accounting Guidance: Service Fee Refunds on Crestline Tickets
content:
**Revenue accounting guidance — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A fee refund returns a service fee charged on a ticket (seat, bag, upgrade, change or same-day change fee) to the original payment.

## Retired clause

The former clause that a fee refund reverses exactly one earlier fee entry on the same ticket, named by the fee entry it reverses, and refunds its full amount to the original payment, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current correction basis for charges made in error.

## Grounds of refund in force

| Ground | When a fee is refunded |
|---|---|
| Seat not provided | A purchased seat was not provided because Crestline reassigned the passenger |
| Bag delayed | A checked bag was delivered late beyond the threshold |
| Upgrade not provided | A paid upgrade was not provided |
| Service unused after an involuntary change | An irregular operation moved the passenger off the segment, or the ticket was refunded involuntarily, so the service went unused |
| Risk-free cancellation | The ticket was voided inside the risk-free window |
| Charged in error | The fee was charged in error |

## Delayed bags

A bag fee is refunded for delay only when a disruption record of type bag delayed on the same ticket shows a bag delivery delay strictly greater than the applicable threshold: the fare brand's domestic threshold on a domestic itinerary, its international threshold on an international flight whose scheduled duration is at most the long-flight threshold in hours, and its long-flight threshold on a longer international flight.

## Limits

- Each fee entry can be refunded at most once.
- Change fees and same-day change fees are refunded only on a risk-free void or when charged in error.
- A service the passenger actually used is never refunded on request, and fees on a ticket cancelled voluntarily for credit are not refunded.

*Hypothetical case.* A domestic bag delivered 12 hours late is not beyond a 12-hour threshold and its fee is not refunded for delay; delivered 13 hours late, it is.

superseded_clauses: A fee refund reverses exactly one earlier fee entry on the same ticket, named by refunded_service_id, and refunds its full amount to the original payment.
